g.text: Add a /api/health endpoint to the server and cover it with tests.
The goal touches the FastAPI layer and the test suite. Before writing anything I want
to see how existing routes are declared in app.py so the new endpoint matches house
style — decorators, response shape, error handling. Then I'll add the smallest
possible test that exercises the route through the real ASGI app, and let the sandbox
pytest run be the verdict instead of assuming it works.
Run full pytest suite in sandbox
Routes are plain @app.get decorators returning dicts, and tests live flat under
